source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(range(10), key=lambda color: sum(cell == color for row in grid for cell in row))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                component.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in component), max(y for y, x in component)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in component), max(x for y, x in component)
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter = {(y, x) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                         if y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)}
            if set(component) == perimeter:
                fill = color + 1 if color % 2 == 0 else color - 1
                for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                    for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
